meta.headline: Co-op for Fears to Fathom: Woodbury Getaway
meta.subhead: Experimental two-player co-op with synchronized characters and scene-specific world state. Full story parity and two-PC Spacewar gameplay remain unverified.

download.label: Woodbury Co-op 0.4.49 test build
download.note: Release/regression checks passed; all ten build scenes passed paired LAN scene/snapshot/rig smoke (Disclaimer boot only). Full story, visual calibration and two-account Spacewar play remain pending.

reVerification.note: Every FindObjectOfType<T> across the non-Cabin sync modules names a real type declared in decompiled/. 93.7% of named field reflections resolve to declared fields in the matching class; misses concentrate on ParkingLotManager and fail safe (the GetField cache returns null and the lookup no-ops).

validation.currentBuildGameplay: Same-DLL TCP-only and TCP+UDP sweeps pass all ten build scenes (Disclaimer boot only), native menu/animation, live appearance changes and Cabin story digests; full story and two-account Spacewar remain pending
validation.note: 873 managed/log checks and both native helper suites pass. Custom traveler appearances persist through six gameplay scenes and the additive Office typing world. Paired graphics verify menu layout, outfit/face previews and both remote bodies after live edits. Both full routes have zero mod runtime errors. The existing native Steam faults remain separate. Two-PC Spacewar, complete story, save/resume, reconnect recovery and all-scene visual calibration remain unverified.
